2152. Counting the Digits of a Number Using a Function

60

Medium

Problem Statement
Read a positive integer and print how many digits it has, using a function that contains a loop.

Description
Read a positive integer num from input. Write a function countDigits that takes an integer parameter, uses a while loop to remove its last digit repeatedly using / 10 while counting how many times this is done, and returns the count. Call the function from main() and print the returned count.
input_spec:
. Write a function countDigits that takes an integer parameter, uses a while loop to remove its last digit repeatedly using / 10 while counting how many times this is done, and returns the count. Call the function from main() and print the returned count.

Input Description
A single positive integer num.
output_spec: Print the number of digits in num.
